brand.tagline: A guest house with its feet in the sand, on Nosy Be

hero.headlineTitle:
THE BEACH
IS TWO STEPS AWAY

story.text: Home Sakalava is five rooms by the water, in Ampasikely, and two hosts who live on site. Boda and Bakoly open their home rather than a hotel room: you have coffee together in the morning, talk about the day ahead, and they tell you where to go.
story.stat: The walls are painted in bright colours, the beds have their canopies and mosquito nets, the furniture comes from craftsmen here. Nothing impersonal, nothing standardised. And a few steps away, the sand of Djamanjary beach.

rooms.intro: All with a private bathroom, walk-in shower, separate entrance, wardrobe, bed linen and towels provided.

items.name: Comfort Triple
items.desc: The most spacious room in the house, with its own terrace facing the sea. Air-conditioned, it comfortably sleeps three.

items.name: Standard Triple
items.desc: A room for three with its terrace and balcony, for breakfast outside without crossing anyone's path.

items.name: Double with garden view
items.desc: Opening onto the garden and the inner courtyard, the only room with a bathtub. Quiet all day long.

items.name: Double with terrace
items.desc: Compact and air-conditioned, with a private terrace and balcony. The right compromise for two.

items.name: Standard Double
items.desc: The simplest: a bed, a bathroom of your own, and the beach two steps away. That is often all you need.

services.title:
A house by the water,
run by the people who live in it
services.note: Services marked "extra charge" are billed on top of the stay.

card.title: A question before you come? Boda and Bakoly answer themselves, in French as well as English.

restaurant.title: The house restaurant
restaurant.text: We eat here at lunch and dinner, in a room that is as much a family kitchen as a restaurant. Seafood above all, and a few European dishes. Cocktails are taken outside.

items.label: Continental or à la carte breakfast
Breakfast served in the room on request

restaurant.note: Special menus on request — let us know when you book.

activities.title: Nosy Be, and Boda who knows the island
activities.text: Boda spent years guiding travellers here. He knows which boat to take, on which day, and with whom. Ask him: it is more reliable than any guidebook.
activities.note: Most of these activities carry an extra charge.

access.title: Getting here and contact
access.text: We are in Ampasikely, in the commune of Dzamandzar, 25 km from Fascene airport. Tell us your arrival time: we can arrange the shuttle.

faq.title:
The questions
we are asked
faq.intro: And if yours is not here, write to us.

items.q: How do I book a room?
items.a: Write to us using the form at the bottom of the page, or through our Facebook page. We reply with availability and the rate. The booking is confirmed directly with us.

items.q: When can I arrive and leave?
items.a: Check-in is between 12:00 and 23:00, check-out between 11:00 and 12:00. If your flight lands outside those hours, let us know: we will work something out.

items.q: How is the stay paid for?
items.a: Payment is made on site, in cash. We ask for no deposit and give you a receipt.

items.q: Do you offer an airport shuttle?
items.a: Yes, on arrival and on departure. Fascene airport is 25 km away. This service is chargeable: send us your flight number and we will give you the price.

items.q: Is there a restaurant on site?
items.a: Yes, open for lunch and dinner. Seafood and European cooking, with vegetarian and gluten-free options. Breakfast can be served in your room if you ask the evening before.

items.q: Are you coming with children or a pet?
items.a: Children of all ages are welcome and we have family rooms. Pets are accepted on request, possibly with a surcharge. Babysitting can be arranged.
French and English. Boda and Bakoly welcome you themselves.
The house is accessible to people with reduced mobility. Write to us before booking so we can point you to the most suitable room.
